_comment: allowed_overlap_mm3: per-pair intersection-volume budget. Anything above it fails.
The non-default budgets below encode joint simplifications still in the model: pins and
clevises drawn straight through their mating parts and the UWU hubs through the side
panels. They were calibrated from the measured overlap over the pose envelope plus a
margin (suggest_budgets.py), and should shrink to the default as the joints get real
bucket_curl_inset_deg: the curl limit is a steel-on-steel hard stop by definition (rule 5),
so the envelope is sampled this far inside it. Set to 0 to include the stop pose itself,
which today shows about 26 cm3 of bucket/arm interpenetration with the arms at ground.
ground_plane.groups fail when they dip below ground (rule 2, crash prevention);
informational_groups are only reported (the bucket lip when dumping with the arms down).
